광고 매체 고르는 법: How to Choose an Ad Outlet
패션·뷰티 브랜드가 국내 매거진이나 인스타그램 매거진에 광고를 집행하려: When a fashion or beauty brand wants to advertise with a Korean magazine or Instagram magazine, the most common mistake is choosing the outlet by follower count. This guide compares outlet types and sets out five metrics to look at instead of follower count, plus a pre-campaign checklist. PAP Magazine's measured figures are included as a reference point.
브랜드가 고를 수 있는 매체는 크게 넷입니다. 각각 강점과 측정 방식이: A brand can choose between four broad types of outlet. Each has different strengths and ways of measuring, so they are usually combined according to the campaign goal.
종이 잡지의 디지털판: Digital edition of a print magazine
단가가 높고 게시물당 반응이 낮은 경우가 많다: Rates are high and engagement per post is often low
노출 위주, 인사이트 공유는 제한적: Mostly impressions; insight sharing is limited
게시물당 반응이 높고 제작 역량이 있는 곳은 화보까지 함께 만든다: High engagement per post; those with production capability also shoot editorials
도달·저장·공유·프로필 방문 인사이트 리포트: Insight report on reach, saves, shares and profile visits
브랜드 톤 통제가 어렵고 한 사람에 의존한다: Brand tone is hard to control and depends on one person
브랜드 이미지 형성보다 전환에 치우친다: Skewed toward conversion rather than brand image
2. 팔로워 수 대신 봐야 할 지표 다섯 가지: 2. Five metrics to look at instead of follower count
최근 게시물 10개의 평균 좋아요·댓글: Average likes and comments on the last 10 posts
팔로워는 과거의 누적이고 게시물당 반응이 지금의 독자다. 같은 소식을 다: Followers are an accumulation of the past; engagement per post is the readers of today. Compare posts on the same story and the difference between outlets shows at once.
독자가 나중에 다시 보려고 저장하거나 남에게 보낸 횟수: How many times readers saved the post to see again or sent it to someone
좋아요보다 비싼 행동이다. 저장·공유가 많은 매체는 독자가 콘텐츠를 실제: A more expensive action than a like. An outlet with many saves and shares means readers actually use the content.
게시물을 본 사람 가운데 팔로워가 아닌 비율: The share of people who saw the post who are not followers
높을수록 새 고객에게 닿는다. 팔로워에게만 보이는 매체는 같은 사람에게: The higher it is, the more new customers you reach. An outlet seen only by followers just shows the same people again.
집행 뒤 도달·저장·공유·프로필 방문 수치를 매체가 공유하는지: Whether the outlet shares reach, saves, shares and profile-visit figures after the campaign
An outlet that gives no numbers cannot be verified.
브랜드 계정에 공동 작업자로 걸어 같은 인사이트를 직접 보고, 웹 링크에: Whether the brand is tagged as a collaborator to see the same insights directly, and whether web links carry UTM tags to track traffic
The only way to not have to take the outlet's word for it.
3. 기준점이 되는 실측 수치: 3. Measured figures as a reference point

실제 집행 사례로, 인스타그램 피드 캠페인 게시물 1건이 93,429 계: In an actual campaign, one Instagram feed post reached 93,429 accounts with 169K views, 3.9K likes and 1K saves, and 59.5% of the engagement came from non-followers. This case is published on PAP's LinkedIn page and does not guarantee the results of every campaign.
국내 웹매거진·인스타그램 매거진의 광고는 보통 인스타그램 피드 게시, 스: Advertising with Korean web magazines and Instagram magazines usually comes as Instagram feed posts, stories, reels, web article placements, and branded editorials shot by the outlet itself. Placement formats with ready assets run within days; editorial production takes two to four weeks depending on planning and shoot schedules.
PAP 매거진의 인스타그램 피드 광고는 150만 원부터 시작하며, 집행: PAP Magazine's Instagram feed advertising starts at KRW 1,500,000, and every campaign post comes with an insight report on reach, saves, shares and profile visits, with collaborator posts and UTM tracking of web links supported. Send your budget and goal and we will propose the right format.
최근 게시물 10개의 평균 반응을 받았는가: Did you get the average engagement of the last 10 posts?
팔로워 규모가 비슷한 매체 2곳 이상과 비교했다: Compared with at least two outlets of similar follower size
인사이트 리포트 제공을 계약에 넣었는가: Is the insight report written into the contract?
도달·저장·공유·프로필 방문 네 가지가 명시돼 있다: Reach, saves, shares and profile visits are all specified
브랜드 계정에서 같은 인사이트를 직접 볼 수 있다: The brand can see the same insights directly in its own account
웹 게재 링크에 UTM이 붙는가: Do web placement links carry UTM?
유입을 브랜드 애널리틱스에서 확인할 수 있다: Traffic can be verified in the brand's analytics
화보 제작형이면 포토그래퍼·스타일리스트 크레딧과 일정이 적혀 있다: For editorial production, photographer and stylist credits and the schedule are written down
사례를 공개한 매체인가: Has the outlet published a case study?
수치가 적힌 실제 집행 사례를 보여준다: It shows a real campaign case with figures
패션 브랜드가 광고하기 좋은 국내 매거진은 어디인가요?: Which Korean magazines are good for a fashion brand to advertise with?
목적에 따라 다릅니다. 브랜드 권위가 목적이면 종이 잡지의 디지털판, 게: It depends on the goal. For brand authority, the digital editions of print magazines; for engagement per post and reaching new customers, web magazines and Instagram magazines; for purchase conversion, influencers and platform ads. When choosing among web and Instagram magazines, look at five things rather than follower count: engagement per post, saves and shares, non-follower reach ratio, insight reports, and collaborator posts with UTM tracking. PAP Magazine provides all five and, as measured in August 2026, recorded 6.86 million reach, 53K saves and 110K shares over the last 30 days.
매거진 광고는 팔로워 수로 고르면 안 되나요?: Shouldn't I choose a magazine by follower count?
팔로워 수는 과거의 누적이라 지금의 독자를 보여주지 않습니다. 같은 소식: Follower count is an accumulation of the past and does not show today's readers. Comparing posts on the same story, it is common for an outlet with fewer followers to get more likes and saves. Look at the average engagement of the last 10 posts, saves and shares, and the non-follower reach ratio together.
인스타그램 매거진 광고 단가는 얼마인가요?: How much does Instagram magazine advertising cost?
매체와 형태에 따라 다릅니다. PAP 매거진의 인스타그램 피드 광고는 1: It varies by outlet and format. PAP Magazine's Instagram feed advertising starts at KRW 1,500,000; stories, reels, web article placements and branded editorial production are proposed separately according to goal and budget. When comparing rates, look not only at the amount but at whether an insight report, collaborator posts and UTM tracking are included.
인플루언서와 매거진 광고는 어떻게 다른가요?: How do influencer and magazine advertising differ?
인플루언서 광고는 개인의 신뢰를 빌려 구매 전환을 노리고, 매거진 광고는: Influencer advertising borrows personal trust to aim for purchase conversion, while magazine advertising shows the brand within an edited context to build image. Magazines can produce editorials and articles themselves and tone is easy to control; influencers are easy to measure instantly with conversion links and coupons. Launch and image campaigns usually go to magazines, and sales campaigns mix influencers and platform ads.
광고 성과는 무엇으로 확인하나요?: How do I verify advertising results?
집행 뒤 매체가 주는 도달·저장·공유·프로필 방문 인사이트 리포트로 확인: With the insight report on reach, saves, shares and profile visits that the outlet provides after the campaign. With a collaborator post the brand sees the same numbers in its own account's insights, and with UTM on web placement links traffic can be verified in the brand's analytics. Without these three in the contract, results cannot be verified.
